config.name: Messages consumed
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT count() FROM yang.yang_messages WHERE kafka_timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND kafka_timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})

config.name: Messages valid
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT countIf(valid) FROM yang.yang_messages WHERE kafka_timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND kafka_timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})

config.name: Messages invalid
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT countIf(NOT valid) FROM yang.yang_messages WHERE kafka_timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND kafka_timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})

config.name: Routers publishing
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT uniqExact(export_address) FROM yang.yang_messages WHERE kafka_timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND kafka_timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})

config.name: Traffic in per router (bit/s)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ts, hostname, sum(r) AS bits_per_second
FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} SECOND) AS ts, hostname, name, avg(rate) AS r
  FROM (
    SELECT assumeNotNull(observation_time) AS t, hostname, name,
      (in_octets - lagInFrame(in_octets) OVER w) * 8 / nullIf(dateDiff('second', lagInFrame(t) OVER w, t), 0) AS rate,
      row_number() OVER w0 AS n
    FROM yang.yang_interfaces_interface_statistics
    WHERE kafka_timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
      AND kafka_timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY export_address, name ORDER BY t ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
           w0 AS (PARTITION BY export_address, name ORDER BY t)
  )
  WHERE n > 1 AND rate >= 0 AND t >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})
  GROUP BY ts, hostname, name
)
GROUP BY ts, hostname
ORDER BY ts ASC

config.name: Traffic out per router (bit/s)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ts, hostname, sum(r) AS bits_per_second
FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} SECOND) AS ts, hostname, name, avg(rate) AS r
  FROM (
    SELECT assumeNotNull(observation_time) AS t, hostname, name,
      (out_octets - lagInFrame(out_octets) OVER w) * 8 / nullIf(dateDiff('second', lagInFrame(t) OVER w, t), 0) AS rate,
      row_number() OVER w0 AS n
    FROM yang.yang_interfaces_interface_statistics
    WHERE kafka_timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
      AND kafka_timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY export_address, name ORDER BY t ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
           w0 AS (PARTITION BY export_address, name ORDER BY t)
  )
  WHERE n > 1 AND rate >= 0 AND t >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})
  GROUP BY ts, hostname, name
)
GROUP BY ts, hostname
ORDER BY ts ASC

config.name: Messages per subscription
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT toStartOfInterval(kafka_timestamp, INTERVAL {intervalSeconds:Int64} SECOND) AS ts, concat('subscription ', toString(subscription_id), if(valid, ' valid', ' invalid')) AS series, count() AS messages FROM yang.yang_messages WHERE kafka_timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND kafka_timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) GROUP BY ts, series ORDER BY ts ASC

config.name: Invalid messages by cause
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT subscription_id, notification_type, failed_stage, substring(error, 1, 160) AS error, count() AS messages FROM yang.yang_messages WHERE NOT valid AND kafka_timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND kafka_timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY messages DESC LIMIT 50

config.name: Interfaces not up, latest state
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT hostname, name AS interface, argMax(admin_status, kafka_timestamp) AS admin, argMax(oper_status, kafka_timestamp) AS oper, max(kafka_timestamp) AS last_seen FROM yang.yang_interfaces_interface_oper_status__interfaces_interface_admin_status GROUP BY hostname, name HAVING oper != 'up' ORDER BY hostname, interface LIMIT 200

config.name: Busiest interfaces, latest octet counters
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT hostname, name AS interface, argMax(in_octets, kafka_timestamp) AS in_octets, argMax(out_octets, kafka_timestamp) AS out_octets, argMax(in_errors, kafka_timestamp) AS in_errors, argMax(out_discards, kafka_timestamp) AS out_discards FROM yang.yang_interfaces_interface_statistics WHERE kafka_timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) AND kafka_timestamp < fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}) GROUP BY hostname, name ORDER BY in_octets DESC LIMIT 20
